key_rules.route_ids: opaque URL-safe registry keys; never logical names
key_rules.logical_names: may contain slash-separated names and are not authorization handles
key_rules.versions: exact immutable versions; validate and escape; reject traversal and ambiguous encoded slashes
key_rules.canonical_urls: responses provide canonical URLs; clients follow them rather than constructing aliases
key_rules.tenant_selection: derived from validated credentials and authorized workspace selection, never an untrusted tenant identifier

byte_budget.reduction: may reduce candidates or omit optional descriptive text
byte_budget.required_content: never truncated; if required content cannot fit, fail the aggregate response with HTTP 413 and code budget_exceeded
byte_budget.batch: each returned item is complete; no item is truncated; per-item errors are allowed; an aggregate response over budget fails 413
